messages.subject: making S4 connection reactive
parts:
Below is my shiny code - all of which works.  However, I wand to make the call to MBS reactive to user input .  However when I edit the code to make it reactive I get the following error

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:4398
Called from: top level 
Browse[1]> shiny::runApp()
Error in (structure(function (input, output)  : 
trying to get slot "ID" from an object (class "reactive") that is not an S4 object 
Error during wrapup: Key / already in use

How do I make MBS reactive?

Glenn

server.R
=======================================
library(BondLab)
library(DT)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)


  shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  #Create output data of the MBS cusip details  
  MBS <- MBS(MBS.id = "bondlabMBS4")

  MBSData <- data.frame()
  MBSData[1,1] <- MBS@ID
  MBSData[2,1] <- MBS@Cusip
  MBSData[3,1] <- MBS@BondType
  MBSData[4,1] <- MBS@Sector
  MBSData[5,1] <- MBS@GWac
  MBSData[6,1] <- MBS@Coupon
  MBSData[7,1] <- MBS@LastPmtDate
  MBSData[8,1] <- MBS@NextPmtDate

  
  colnames(MBSData) <- "Description"
  rownames(MBSData) <- c("Cusip:", "Bond ID:", "Bond Type:", "Sector:", "GrossWac", "Coupon",
                         "Last Pmt Date:", "Next Pmt Date:")
  
  output$BondData <- renderDataTable(MBSData,
                        options = list(fixedColumns = TRUE,
                        autowidth = FALSE,
                        scroller = FALSE, 
                        searching = FALSE,
                        paging = FALSE,
                        ordering = FALSE,
                        info = FALSE),
                  filter = 'none',
                  escape = TRUE)
    
  
  #Create Termstructure date for ggplot 
  output$fwdcurve <- renderPlot({
  rates <- Rates(trade.date = "01-10-2013")
  Data <- TermStructure(rates.data = rates, method = "ns")
  Data <- data.frame(cbind(Data@period[1:length(Data@date)],
                            Data@spotrate[1:length(Data@date)],
                            Data@forwardrate[1:length(Data@date)]))
    colnames(Data) <- c("period", "Spot", "Forward")
    Data <- melt(Data, id = "period")
    
    curve <- ggplot(Data, aes(x = period /12, y = value/100, colour = variable, linetype = variable)) +
              geom_line(size = 1.0) +
              labs(colour = "Legend", 
                   linetype = "Legend", x = "Maturity (years)", y = "Swap Rate") +
              scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
              theme_minimal()+
              theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12))+
              theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(size = .25, color = "grey")) +
              theme(legend.position= "bottom", 
                    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white")) +
              theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15)) +
              theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 20)) +
              theme(legend.text=element_text(size= 15))
      
              print(curve)
                            })
   
  
  })
